newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen consolidating after rise.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen consolidating after rise.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were expected consolidate on Tuesday as the market goes through a correction after rising by more than 40 points during the past two weeks, brokers said.
"The rise was a bit too much and we are seing a mild correction," said Rajiv Casiechitty of brokerage C.T. Smith. "We may see the market moving within a narrow range today."
Brokers said the index had risen sharply in June after analysts upgraded earnings forecasts for 1997 and 1998.
But on Monday, the all share index closed two points lower at 771.8.
Other brokers said the market was likely to consolidate on widespread retail activity and limited institutional activity.
"Foreigners are looking for various lines, but it is difficult to find what they want at these levels," said Hiran Seneviratne of Lanka Securities.
"But I doubt they will move up significantly to find the quantities they are looking for," he said.
